KMS data encryption, the key named without a version

span.p:
Disk encryption set des-<cell> (cluster-wide, set at creation)
→ ephemeral OS disks of the system pool and every zone node
+ encryption at host

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 243) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 243) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Disk encryption set des-sf
→ OS disks of the system pool and the zone pools
+ encryption at host

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 243) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Disk encryption set des-sf-<zone>, one per zone
→ StorageClasses <zone>-premium-zrs, … and the zone's Azure Files account
→ persistent volumes and backups of the zone
Azure Policy: a PVC only on its own zone's classes

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 243) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Not possible in AKS: a disk key per node pool → one OS-disk key per cluster, application data separated per zone
Rotation: a new key version every 12 months, no expiry dates; disk encryption sets and KMS data encryption follow the versionless key
